name: rss-feeds
description: Watch RSS/Atom feeds: feeds mini-app with a 30-min poll job + rss connector. New items become events mini-apps can subscribe to.
post_install: Restart the platform: docker compose restart endpoint-platform (applies 003_feeds.sql, installs feedparser, hot-loads the app).
Add a feed: curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:{{PORT_PLATFORM}}/api/feeds/feeds -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"url": "https://example.com/feed.xml"}'
Polling runs every 30 minutes (manifest job); new items publish the feeds.new_items event.
Mini-apps can subscribe to feeds.new_items in their manifest, or import connectors.rss directly.
